name: Fiachna mac Báetáin

attributes.attribute: bought victory by sleeping with Manannán Mac Lir
arranged for Fiachna to win the battle

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Fiachna mac Báetáin was a possible historical king. His wife Caíntigern bought his victory. She slept with the sea god Manannán Mac Lir. The god desired her so much that he arranged for Fiachna to win the battle in return for her favor. The king's genealogy suggests a divinity or totem ancestor. His mother reportedly conceived him parthenogenetically.

okr.objective: Fiachna mac Báetáin is a possible historical king who won a battle through his wife's bargain with the sea god.
key_results: Fiachna mac Báetáin may have been a historical king.
